competitions_competition_id_check.name: competitions_competition_id_check

matchmaking_settings_profile_check.name: matchmaking_settings_profile_check

question_sets_set_id_check.name: question_sets_set_id_check
question_sets_set_id_check.value: (length(set_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND set_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]*')

question_versions_check.name: question_versions_check
question_versions_check.value: (json_type(payload) = 'object') AND (length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) <= 16384) AND ((payload ->> 'id') = question_id) AND (CAST(payload ->> 'version' AS INTEGER) = version) AND (json_type(payload, '$.id') IS NOT NULL) AND (json_type(payload, '$.version') IS NOT NULL)

question_versions_question_id_check.name: question_versions_question_id_check

appeal_resolution.name: appeal_resolution
appeal_resolution.value: ("quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."operator_id" IS NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."resolution" IS NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."decision" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."operator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("quiz_game_sanction_appeals"."resolution")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)

user_report_resolution.name: user_report_resolution
user_report_resolution.value: ("quiz_game_user_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "quiz_game_user_reports"."operator_id" IS NULL AND "quiz_game_user_reports"."resolution" IS NULL) OR ("quiz_game_user_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_game_user_reports"."operator_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quiz_game_user_reports"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("quiz_game_user_reports"."resolution")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000)
